llc oracle fidelity: 4 windows (0x2bf18 0x33c50 0x34558 0x567d8) differ only by use-list order, which bitcode does not preserve; residual ties of this kind can only be driven by the IR, not by options

source hint: -tail-dup-size=3 moves 0x1489f8 trade::buy_exact_quote from 0.851 to 0.915 at unchanged size. Its output has the same 1021 instructions; only greedy-RA ties flip (r6<->r9 for the 5th argument, as the original has it, plus r8/r6 and r7/r9 pairs), because early tail duplication changes the pre-RA CFG. Part of the 0x1489f8 residual is therefore an RA tie that reacts to pre-RA CFG shape (ledger 15b19b83)
